_comment: Repo defaults for the model placement registry. Shape only: unit/service names, engines, profiles, affinity, and the config inventory. Measured footprints (resident_gpu_mib, host_rss_mib, device totals) are machine state and live in ~/.uap/model-registry.json, deep-merged over this file. A config without a measurement is 'unmeasured' and fails closed: it may be served if already resident, but it can never be loaded or evicted. See docs/specs/operator-model-placement.md §4.1. retired_local_aliases is the single source the Droid sync (scripts/sync-local-agent-configs.sh) migrates from — append the just-retired alias there on every arm swap.

dflash-q3_k_m.note: lucebox-hub DFlash speculative-decoding server (Qwen3.6-27B Q3_K_M target + draft head); machine profile: ~/.config/uap/dflash-server.env. The ugc-factory brain (pay2u tools/ugc-factory) requests 'qwen3.6-27b' through the UAP proxy, so placement auto-loads this config on demand — run `uap models measure` to record this machine's footprint before it can load (fail-closed). The Claude contract ids are advertised here too: the proxy serves them locally (ANTHROPIC_PASSTHROUGH_MODELS=__local_only__), and without a registry mapping the placement gate would 409-park every SDK client that checks /v1/models and then asks for one.

Advertises qwen3.8-flash-next-gsq-rco-iq3_s at /v1/models when serving - deliberately NOT the historical qwen3.8-flash-next-iq3_s, which stays in retired_local_aliases; the arm's own alias is NOT in the retired list (switchable, not retired). gemma-4-31b-it-qat-ud-q4_k-xl-mtp.note: Optimal-speed Gemma 4 arm — user-directed 2026-11-15: Google's flagship DENSE 30.7B IT (60 layers, hybrid attention: 1024-token sliding window + global layers with unified KV, 256K native ctx capped at 48k by the 24 GB VRAM budget — smoke-evidenced 2026-11-15: the 131k q8_0 KV (5.3 GiB) cudaMalloc-OOMs atop the weights+draft+buffers, 64k+ubatch512 stayed ~700 MiB short against the 4.1 GiB desktop baseline (the hyperqwen gpu-util lesson), and the probed fit is 49152 ctx + ubatch 256 with the MTP head aboard; the box's gemma4 profile doctrine says step ctx down before touching KV quant (q4_0 degrades Gemma, measured) or dropping the MTP head; 48k sits above the yasakani arm's 32k floor, configurable thinking, native function calling, Apache-2.0; MMLU Pro 85.2 / AIME 89.2 / LiveCodeBench 80.0) on llama.cpp master 5a4afd8 (fresh build at ~/llama.cpp, CUDA 13.4 from ~/cuda-13.4 + gcc-13, native sm_86 — the FIRST llama.cpp-arm in the fleet; the Strata family has NO gemma-4 arch support, upstream 0.2.13 included, so this arm builds llama-server directly with no wrapper, the llama.cpp-arm doctrine). QUANT: unsloth/gemma-4-31B-it-qat-GGUF at the pinned rev (43cc1ae) — Google QAT (quantization-aware-trained) UD-Q4_K_XL 17.3 GB: the memory bandwidth of any 4-bit with higher fidelity, which also lifts MTP acceptance (unsloth measured QAT+MTP 1.5-2.2x on dense Gemma 4; the box's own gemma4-26b profile A/B confirms >2x on dense vs a no-op on the MoE A4B). DRAFTER: mtp-gemma-4-31B-it.gguf 280 MB (the QAT-derived MTP head, Google's separately-trained assistant line) via --model-draft + --spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-n-max 4 / n-min 1 / p-min 0.75 — tune n-max 1-6 by the measured /metrics acceptance after the smoke. KV q8_0 (Gemma is KV-cheap: sliding window on most layers), one slot, 48k ctx, ubatch 256 (probe-fit). Sampling: temp 1.0 / top-p 0.95 / top-k 64 / min-p 0.0, no repeat penalty (Gemma dislikes penalties; loop-steering is proxy-side). --jinja REQUIRED: server-side rendering of the GGUF-embedded <|turn>/<|tool_call> DSL into OpenAI-shaped tool_calls — without it tool calling silently breaks (the gemma4 profile doctrine, caught pre-smoke). --metrics on (acceptance tuning); --cache-ram 32768 host prompt cache (undersized = 87% of prefill time re-doing evicted work, measured on this box); --prio 2 (decode priority under desktop co-tenancy); --slot-save-path ~/.cache/uap/llama-slots (cross-session slot save/restore, UAP PR #179; the proxy degrades to full reprocessing without it). TEXT-ONLY by design (no mmproj; mmproj-F16 1.2 GB in the same repo is addable later). Advertises gemma-4-31b-qat-ud-q4_k-xl-mtp at /v1/models (the --alias; single alias so the std::set ASCII-first id quirk does not apply). inference-panel id gemma (unit uap-gemma-server.service, branch feature/010-gemma-backend). Posture (config basalt-inkling2-mx8.json, unit uap-basalt-inkling2-server.service, inference-panel id basalt-inkling2): gpu 0, kv fp8 (halves the cache; fp16 the other valid value), max-context 1048576 (the model's FULL window), vision dynamic (the engine's own encoder; 0 VRAM at rest, borrows expert-cache slots per image), DSpark on by default (--spec 8: the last accepted token plus the block, up to 7 drafts a pass, verified - output is the model's own), port 8080. The caches stay ELASTIC (full-attention visits back their first 32768 positions and grow; least-routed experts spill to page-locked RAM and come back). The engine logs at ~/.cache/basalt/<id>/. Supersedes the nvfp4-q8 config (the 0.5.5-era pack, kept on disk; its measured overlay entry is pruned on this uplift). Revert: point the unit back at basalt-inkling2.json (the q8 pack). Run `uap models measure` against it before placement loads it (fail-closed).

squid-fp8.note: The squid5090 ENGINE arm - user-directed 2026-11-25 per x.com/fishjar/status/2125198935870607390: tensorfish/squid5090 (Apache-2.0, pinned fda96e9d) is a zero-Python single-binary TigerStyle Zig + Blackwell CUDA (sm_120a) inference engine built at ~/dev/squid5090 (zig 0.17.1 from the ziglang tarball, CUDA 13.4 from ~/cuda-13.4, `zig build -Dcuda-path=...`, binary 19 MB at zig-out/bin/squid5090) serving Thinking Machines Lab's ORIGINAL HF checkpoint safetensors (thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini at c9d02830 - NOT the basalt-converted pack: a fresh 19.5 GB download + the release's own DSpark drafter mtp.safetensors + tiktoken tokenizer). Posture (unit uap-squid-inkling2-server.service, inference-panel id squid-inkling2): serve --mode fp8 --kv q4 --ctx 524288 --mtp 7 --spec-threshold 0.80 --temp 1.0 --top-p 0.95 --model-name "Inkling 2 Mini" - the accuracy-default fp8 mode keeps the release's OWN L0-19 NVFP4 + L20-23 MXFP8 experts and official BF16 routers/controllers (upstream bench: 0.0058-0.0094 KLD, 26x smaller PPL delta than 4-bit) with FP8 dense/lm_head and q4 KV for the 512K window; --model-name pins the SAME wire id as the basalt arm (the engine ignores requested ids but /v1/models then stays uniform across arms, so pinned clients survive switches). DSpark drafts adaptively {2,4,8} by Markov confidence and is verified (output is the model's own). Upstream cross-engine bench (same 5090 class): fp8/q4 beats basalt v0.5.7 MX8 on all 4 T=1.0 decode benches (313.5 chat / 272.1 prose / 356.8 code / 456.4 copy) and matches it on cold 18.9K prefill (16,855 tok/s HTTP); this box VERIFIED 2026-11-25: cold load 2.5s, exact-echo SMOKE-ECHO-7F3A finish=stop, native tool call get_weather {"city":"Paris"} finish=tool_calls, decode 322/605/347 tok/s (code/counting/chat, dl 1.95-4.43), ~24.2 GiB VRAM (17.0 weights + 6.0 runtime + graphs), single-user c=1, 32 MiB request buffer (HTTP 413 above), tools/tool_calls native, NO constrained grammar.
